title: Two Trading Apps
intro: Toddy is curious about investing, the safe way. Two apps came up in a search.
One behaves like a real, regulated firm. One is built to take your money.

screen.context: Two trading apps, side by side.

v.text: Reg. no. you can check on the regulator's own site
Any time, small fee from your balance

licence_b.label: Badge, no number
licence_b.lens: A tick picture with no registration number to check.
licence_b.why: Real firms give a number you can check on the regulator's own website.

withdraw_b.label: Pay to withdraw
withdraw_b.lens: You must pay before you can take your own money out.
withdraw_b.why: Fees to unlock your money are how fake platforms take even more.

support_b.label: Support only in DMs
support_b.lens: No help inside the app, only private messages.
support_b.why: Real firms have support in the app or on their official site.

new_b.label: 3 weeks old
new_b.lens: The site appeared three weeks ago.
new_b.why: Fake platforms pop up and vanish fast.

bonus_b.label: Deposit bonus pressure
bonus_b.why: Bonuses and "today only" push you to deposit before you check.

risk_a.label: Risk warning
risk_a.lens: It warns you can lose money.

licence_a.label: Checkable licence
licence_a.lens: A registration number you can look up yourself.
licence_a.why: Checkable on the regulator's own site, not just a picture.

withdraw_a.label: Normal withdrawals
withdraw_a.lens: Withdraw any time; fees come out of your balance.

logo_b.label: Rocket logo
logo_b.why: Logos prove nothing either way, even rockets.

actions.label: Sign up for Brenvoy Trade Pro, the returns are better
Look up both on the official regulator's register
Report Brenvoy Trade Pro, then check Ostrel's number on the regulator's site

trap.title: Brenvoy Trade Pro · Sign up
trap.ask: Deposit today and get a 50% bonus. Guaranteed 2% daily!

block_report.line: Reported. The site went onto an official warning list a week later.

verify.line: Ostrel's number matched the register. Brenvoy Trade Pro wasn't there at all.

pick_b.line: The "profits" grew on screen. The 20% unlock fee was paid. Nothing came out.

what_if.pick_b: "Pay 20% to withdraw" means your money can't really come out. Check the licence number on the regulator's own site first.
what_if.verify: Checking was exactly right. Reporting the fake as well helps it get shut down.

golden_rule: If you must pay to take your own money out, it's not your money any more. Check licences on the regulator's own site.

quick_check.q: A trading app asks for a 20% "unlock fee" before you can withdraw. What does that mean?

options.text: It's a fake platform: stop paying and report it

quick_check.explain: Real platforms take fees from your balance. "Pay first to withdraw" is how fake ones take more.

hints.nudge: Compare how each app lets you take money out.

decide_q: Which app is safe, and what will you do?
